breakpoints.note: The saved ASan stack proves the malformed archive was admitted far enough to reach `ExtractCurrentFile()` and take the stored-file branch into `UnstoreFile()` instead of a decompression path.

On the crashing path, this parsed `hd->UnpSize` must exceed the signed `int64` range expected by `UnstoreFile`; otherwise line 790 could not inflate a bounded read count into the oversized `File::Write` length seen by ASan.

The fix changes archive size fields such as `FileHeader::UnpSize` to signed `int64` so the earlier negative-size clamp can work, and it rewrites this exact block to use signed `ReadSize` and `WriteSize` values while only calling `UnpWrite()` when `WriteSize > 0`.
